baseline_models.mechanism: The exception fences the speaker's effective disposition and answerability inside a minimal sphere: his own person and one bonded relative. The line concerns governable agency more naturally than ownership of the brother.

activation_trace.role: Possession and disposition supply the literal field, while the exception sharply limits their functional reach.
The thing's own self makes the speaker's person the irreducible unit for which he can answer.
Kinship supplies the one other person joined to the remaining sphere of action.

changed_reading.before: A flat declaration that the speaker owns only himself and his brother.
changed_reading.after: An audit of effective agency: he claims no command over the group and can answer only for himself and the brother still joined to him.

baseline_models.mechanism: The imperative asks the Lord to distinguish two relational sides, while the doubled 'between' gives the distinction a two-sided interval. The requested act can therefore be juridical and classificatory before it is physical.

activation_trace.role: Lordship and sovereignty identify the addressee able to make the distinction effective.
Discrimination between two things supplies the operative act of adjudication.
The interval between two sides gives the judgment a relational and spatial boundary.

changed_reading.before: A request simply to move the speaker away from bad people.
changed_reading.after: A request for sovereign adjudication that makes the true affiliation boundary visible and consequential.

baseline_models.mechanism: The people remain grammatically a collective, but the shell-exit image in their qualifier portrays their failure as a breach from a containing order. The label names a movement out, not merely a static bad quality.

activation_trace.role: A human collective supplies the social container whose coherence is at issue.
A moist date leaving its skin supplies the literal breach image and renders failure as exit from containment.

changed_reading.before: The final adjective is a generic moral insult.
changed_reading.after: The adjective diagnoses an enacted rupture: the group has moved outside a containing norm while retaining its social name.

baseline_models.mechanism: The brother branch can image a fastening, while 'between' can name an existing connection as well as a gap. The prayer then selectively reconfigures relations: preserve the pair's tether while distinguishing that pair from the larger group.

activation_trace.role: A fastening or tether gives the brother relation a structural role as the bond that remains.
The connection standing between parties keeps 'between' from functioning only as empty distance.
Discrimination selects which relation is retained and which affiliation is severed.

changed_reading.before: The speaker is isolated except for an incidental relative.
changed_reading.after: The focus preserves one functioning relational tether and asks that this surviving bond be distinguished from failed collective affiliation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet moves from binding obligations, through an explicit heard-and-obeyed compact, to undoing a compact. That sequence turns the focus shell-exit image into a covenant mechanism: the refusal immediately before the focus is another practical unbinding, and the requested distinction formalizes a rupture already enacted.

activation_trace.role: An obligatory compact supplies the binding frame within which later exit can count as breach.
The confirmed covenant gives the group's pledged hearing and obedience institutional force.
Undoing what was firmly made supplies the packet's explicit breach operation.
The date exiting its skin converts the covenant sequence into the focus ayah's compact material image.

structural_cues: 5:1 opens with fulfilling bonds; 5:7 states the heard-and-obeyed compact; 5:13 names its undoing.
The categorical refusal in 5:24 supplies a local enactment immediately before the focus petition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies binding, pledged obedience, breach, and refusal; I infer that the refusal realizes another breach and that the prayer asks to recognize it. A live alternative is that the prayer seeks consequence without covenantal formalization.

changed_reading.before: Separate compliant individuals from a generally disobedient crowd.
changed_reading.after: Ratify a covenant boundary already produced by the crowd's own refusal and exit from its pledged obligation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Comprehensive dominion belongs to God, yet the people are also called kings; entry is paired with reliance, while refusal is paired with sitting and sending Moses and his Lord to act. The focus limitation of ملك therefore marks the collapse of delegated collective agency, not a denial that the group had received status or capacity.

activation_trace.role: Sovereignty and dominion set the scale contrast between contested human control and God's comprehensive rule.
Conferred kingship supplies public status and potential agency to the very collective that later refuses.
Reliance supplies a mode of acting through trust rather than an excuse for inaction.
Sitting back from action supplies the concrete collapse of the group's delegated agency.
Disposition and control become the speaker's honestly delimited sphere after collective refusal.

structural_cues: 5:17-18 reserve comprehensive dominion for God, while 5:20 says the people were made kings.
5:23 couples entering with reliance; 5:24 sends action upward to Moses and his Lord while the speakers remain seated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the dominion hierarchy, conferred kingship, active trust, and refusal; I infer that 5:25 audits practical command and answerability. A live alternative is that 'kings' in 5:20 denotes status without any implied capacity to act.

changed_reading.after: He identifies the endpoint of failed delegation: a people given royal standing refuse agency, so his accountable perimeter contracts to self and brother.

context_deltas.mechanism: The resistant group makes others' exit the condition of its own entry; the responsive pair instead names a gate to be crossed. The focus reverses the failed condition by moving the decisive boundary inside the addressed collective: the issue is no longer who must leave the land first, but which side of obedience each party occupies.

activation_trace.role: Literal entry supplies the action the group postpones behind a condition.
Literal exit supplies the external displacement demanded before the group will act.
A gate supplies the concrete threshold through which responsive action can begin.
Discrimination relocates the decisive line from external occupants to internal affiliation.
The two-sided interval makes the relocated threshold explicit in the focus construction.

structural_cues: 5:21 commands entry; 5:22 conditions entry on another group's exit; 5:23 points to a gate; 5:25 asks for an internal distinction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an entry-exit condition, a gate, and the focus boundary; I infer a reversal from an external obstacle model to an internal allegiance threshold. A live alternative is that the repeated spatial language is only narrative staging.

changed_reading.before: The focus asks for ordinary distance from the troublesome group.
changed_reading.after: The focus adjudicates the real threshold after the group mislocated it: responsiveness, not the prior exit of an opponent, determines the two sides.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet repeatedly bars aversion from distorting justice and elsewhere names hatred explicitly when hatred is the mechanism. This weakens an equation of فرق with hostile excommunication; the focus can request a just distinction and consequence without assigning hatred to the speaker.

activation_trace.role: Aversion and hostility supply the affect that the surrounding instruction refuses to let govern judgment.
Equity supplies the positive judicial constraint on any distinction between groups.
Just judgment supplies the repeated corrective against affective partiality.
Explicit hatred supplies a contrastive vocabulary that the focus ayah itself does not use.
Distinguishing two things supports adjudication without itself supplying hostile affect.

structural_cues: 5:2 and 5:8 twice refuse letting aversion toward a people produce transgression or injustice.
5:14 explicitly places enmity and hatred between parties, whereas 5:25 uses distinction vocabulary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a justice constraint and separate hatred vocabulary; I infer that hostility is not required by the focus petition. A live alternative is that the distinction is just while still carrying unexpressed grief or anger.

changed_reading.before: Separate us because we hate and repudiate them.
changed_reading.after: Judge the affiliation boundary justly; consequence and distance need not be rendered as personal hatred.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate response implements distinction through denied access and a measured period of wandering, while repeating the shell-exit label. This recasts separation as a temporal-spatial regime imposed on the refusing group rather than an explicit declaration of permanent interpersonal hatred.

activation_trace.role: Prohibition and prevention supply the operative form taken by the requested distinction.
The repeated shell-exit image identifies the same breach-defined group as subject to the restriction.
Separation into parts supplies the petition whose concrete implementation the next ayah specifies.

structural_cues: 5:26 quantifies the restriction as forty years and uses the branchless root ت ي ه for wandering in the land.
The response restricts access to the named place rather than explicitly commanding hatred between persons.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the petition, a forty-year prohibition, wandering, and the repeated group label; I infer that 5:26 narrates one implementation of the separation. A live alternative is that the ban is punishment only, not a protective or rehabilitative interval.

changed_reading.before: The prayer demands an unqualified and permanent person-to-person severance.
changed_reading.after: Its immediate answer is a finite access boundary and wandering consequence for the breach-defined group, leaving the ultimate relational scope unstated.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats a kin pair as a portable institutional unit and does not identify that pair with the two men of 5:23. It remains anchored in self-plus-brother, the brother-tether branch, and the immediate active-pair versus sitting-group contrast. Render it only as a structural echo, not as a historical identification.

activation_trace.role: The man branch, carried by a dual surface in the packet, supplies a two-person speaking unit.
Entry gives the responsive two-person unit an action-oriented posture.
Abstention from action supplies the contrasting posture of the larger speakers.
The tether image turns brotherhood into the connective structure of the surviving pair.
A connection standing between parties lets the pair function as a minimal relational unit.

changed_reading.before: Only two isolated individuals remain available.
changed_reading.after: Obedience may survive as a tethered two-person micro-community capable of action when the larger collective immobilizes itself.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material analogy: a fruit exits its skin, people demand exit before entry, and the breach-defined group is then denied entry to land. It remains anchored in the focus qualifier and the packet's entry-exit sequence, but it must be rendered as exploratory container logic, not as an etymological equation of skin, covenant, and territory.

activation_trace.role: Entry supplies the commanded movement into the territorial container.
Exit supplies the displacement that the refusing group wrongly makes a prerequisite.
The date leaving its skin supplies the focus ayah's material image of breached containment.
Prevention supplies the reciprocal result: the breach-defined group loses entry to the bounded place.

changed_reading.before: The group is morally bad and is then kept out.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, those who enact exit from a normative container meet a mirrored loss of entry into the territorial container.

strongest_changes: The focus becomes an audit of collapsed delegated agency: named kings become sitters, and the speaker limits answerability to self and brother.
The entry-exit-gate sequence relocates the decisive threshold from external occupants to internal responsiveness.
Binding, compact, breach, and the shell-exit image make the requested distinction a formalization of enacted covenant rupture.
summary.what_was_special: The packet made the focus a hinge where sovereignty, agency, covenant, and spatial threshold converge without collapsing into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: ملك may emphasize command, responsibility, cohesion, or status in different parts of the mechanism.
The self-and-brother pair may echo the two men of 5:23 structurally without being identical to them.
The forty-year response clearly bounds access, but the packet does not settle whether its purpose is punitive, protective, rehabilitative, or several at once.
